CASH ONLY. Not advised by anyone that paying by card was an issue in advance. Have been to this bar several times prior and always been fine to use card. This last visit when asking for the bill to pay they advised cash only. Asked more questions and ascertained fairly quickly the machine was just turned off and they just wanted patrons to pay cash. I didn't have an ATM card with me so super painful trying to work through this with a manager and team members who had no capacity to resolve the issue. Place is rough anyway so wont bother going back (other than to pay the bill), just disappointing the attitude and communication of the manager and bar team. Plenty of better places to eat / drink in Danang - don't waste your time.

No other bar in Da Nang … came close.
Mar 2025 • Couples
DA NANG city visit 
From 08/03-11/03/25
Bamboo Bar 2 
Frequented on 3 evenings 

Feeling of open space across all the 3 floors. Top floor had a pool table & balcony area, with plenty of seating all around.

Found this bar on first night in Da Nang, then was drawn to it for other two nights while visiting Da Nang.

Not only for its wide range of sports shown on its many screens within. 
Bonus point to staff- 👍Request taken & granted in tuning in to play the six nations rugby for us, (on its concluding weekend). 

Other comments/observations- 

Toilets- decent - (as always while in Vietnam I found) no harm in carrying some ‘mountain money’ ladies, encase should run out towards the end of the night. 

Food - good & hearty alcohol complimenting food the food served. 
Suit all types of night, ranging from : a line stomach night; or a ‘going out out’ night ; also for a ‘pint & feed’ night & everything in between ! 

Drinks- array of cocktails, lagers & spirits available. 
Can recommend, as sampled: 
LIIT & Saigon draft

Seating- mixture of bar stools & poser tables mostly. All reasonably comfortable 

Staff- all brilliantly individual, seemed caring to their regular base. As well as welcoming to new comers & had a sense of fun needed for such a social venue. 

Music- great beats/tunes in my humble- mostly a mix of old & new style rock played while there. 

Open until 0300 hours 

Wouldn’t hesitate in recommending this venue to anyone who enjoys a tipple or two, in light hearted surroundings… 

The bar & it’s staff have also been known to assist those passing through the town and/or those who have decided to stay a while in Da Nang… 
ex pat clubs are said to meet up within on regular basis & chat over coffee
